_what: HydroRecon run at commissioned DoED-licensed plants from one coordinate each, letting the engine choose its own scheme. Capacity only — DoED publishes no head or design flow.
_caveat: A licensed capacity is an economic choice, not a property of the river. Individual rows are weak evidence; the distribution is the measurement.
_headline: The ratio below is NOT an accuracy score. HydroRecon is asked for the largest scheme in its search window and the largest always sits at the window edge, so the ratio partly measures the window. The measurement is impliedWaterwayKm: the shortest waterway at which the engine reaches the capacity that was actually built. Nepali run-of-river headraces run about 1-10 km; a median inside that range means the built plant lies on the engine's own curve at a buildable length.
